text:
tim: quick heads up — saw latency spikes when routing mixed-length batches. thinking about a shape-aware routing + cache-hint header to avoid polluting the KV cache with long one-off sequences.

anna: can you paste the log sample?

 tim: sure, snippet:
```log
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] route=default model=gpt-open-30b seq=4096 batch=1 kernel=attn-cu90 latency=820ms mem=31.2GB
[2026-03-18 09:12:03] route=default model=gpt-open-30b seq=32 batch=16 kernel=attn-cu90 latency=22ms mem=12.1GB
```

raj: suggestion: add a per-request hint header `X-Cache-Hint: preserve|evict|prefetch` so clients (or our autotuner) can signal intent.

mike: prefer server-side only for now. clients might set wrong hints. but i like a canonical internal field we can set from routing/autotune.

 tim: agreed — internal header + metrics. minimal API: allow model-level defaults and per-request override from our routing layer.

anna: worry: how do we prevent cache churn? if many small seqs say `preserve` and one long seq also `preserve` we'll evict useful entries.

raj: idea: cache-key = model+layer+kv-shape; add TTL and an eviction score that penalizes single-use long sequences.

mike: and use shape buckets in routing: key = (seq_bin, batch_bin). route traffic to kernel tuned for that bucket. fewer kernel switches.

 tim: example routing config (draft):
```yaml
model: gpt-open-30b
buckets:
  - seq_max: 64
    batch_min: 8
    kernel: 'fast-small'
  - seq_max: 512
    batch_min: 2
    kernel: 'balanced'
  - seq_max: 4096
    batch_min: 1
    kernel: 'memory-optimized'
cache:
  default_ttl: 300
  eviction_policy: 'score_based'
  score_params: {reuse_weight: 2, size_penalty: 0.5}
```

infra-bot: deploy queued: shape-routing-config v1 -> staging :rocket:

sre-ops: how will we surface regressions? need charts: cache_evictions/sec, avg_latency_per_bucket, kernel_switches/sec, cost_per_token

anna: short-term experiment plan: rollout 5% traffic with `prefetch` for seq>1024, monitor latency, mem pressure and eviction rate for 48h.

raj: also set a guard: if mem_pressure>85% then automatically flip long-seq hints to `evict`.

mike: runtime change: when hint=prefetch do a prefill that preallocs KV entries but mark them low-priority; evictable if pressure spikes.

 tim: also adding a fast-path: if batch_shape matches existing warm cache we bypass heavy kernel probe.

anna: tests: synthetic trace generator + randomized seq distribution, plus a few production traffic replays.

raj: note: telemetry schema needs `seq_bin` and `cache_hint` fields.

tim: i'll write an RFC capturing routing keys, cache-hint semantics, and rollout plan. @raj @anna @mike please add notes to RFC draft.

mike: will prototype the router changes next week.

anna: i'll add the dashboards + alert playbook.

 tim: thanks all. filing follow-ups: 1) RFC, 2) staging experiment, 3) telemetry + dashboards. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
